Establish and document the company’s accounting policies and technical positions, and defend them with auditors and senior leadership. Lead revenue recognition under ASC 606 on complex, multi-element hardware, software and services contracts, and advise sales, legal and deal teams on contract terms before signature. Own accounting for leases (ASC 842), stock-based compensation (ASC 718), debt and financing transactions, contract costs (ASC 340-40) and foreign operations (ASC 830). Own the external audit relationship and lead the annual audit, negotiating significant accounting and scope matters with the audit partner. Define the SOX readiness roadmap and deliver a SOX-ready control environment within 12 months, while owning the accounting workstreams for IPO readiness. Own accounting and compliance for government contracts, and partner with tax and treasury on intercompany, transfer pricing, statutory audits and local filings across international entities. Set the accounting systems roadmap, scaling NetSuite and the surrounding procure-to-pay, billing, payroll, inventory/MRP and consolidation stack, and automate and standardize close and reporting as the business grows. Lead and develop a growing accounting and tax organization, including hiring managers, defining performance standards and career paths, and owning the department budget. Requirements: Experience leading an accounting function as a Controller or Director at a high-growth company. A track record of building and leading multi-layer accounting teams, including hiring and developing managers. Deep US GAAP judgment, particularly ASC 606 on complex hardware-plus-services arrangements; you can write a technical memo and defend it. Experience leading external audits and building SOX-ready controls before they were required. Multi-entity, multi-currency consolidation experience across international subsidiaries. Executive presence: able to explain complex accounting matters clearly to executives, the board, auditors and investors. Nice to Have: Active CPA license and a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or a related field. Big 4 or national-firm public accounting experience. IPO or S-1 experience, or Controller time at a newly public company. Government contracting accounting experience (FAR, DFARS, DCAA, CAS) and related systems. Background in hardware, infrastructure, deep tech or other capital-intensive sectors. International operations experience across multiple regions. Location: Fully remote (US-based) Compensation: $275k - $300k + Bonus (plan launching in 2027) + Equity At Harmonic, we are dedicated to fostering an inclusive and equitable workplace. review_candidates.title: Client Operations Specialist (Remote)
review_candidates.location: San Salvador, San Salvador, El Salvador
review_candidates.description: Client Operations Specialist — EdgeOS (100% Remote) Salary: $1,300 USD / month Location: 100% Remote — LATAM only Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, U.S. business hours Are you the person everyone leans on to keep things organized and moving? Do you take ownership without being asked, and stay calm when everything's on fire? This is a growth role with full training, built for someone early to mid in their career who already runs things naturally and wants to grow into a true operator. About the role You'll help our clients (busy business owners in roofing, restoration, and construction) build and actually run an operational "OS" for their business: workflow engines, company playbooks, scorecards, dashboards, meeting rhythms, and internal memo systems. Your job isn't just to build these systems; it's to make sure they get used. You'll be the operator who keeps the owner focused, on track, and accountable to the plan. We'll give you full training in our EdgeOS system and in estimating and claims skills for the insurance/roofing/restoration niche. You bring the instincts; we'll teach the rest. Who thrives here You take ownership. When something's blocked, you find a way around it instead of waiting. You're a natural problem-solver. When something breaks or gets messy, you diagnose it, find options, and move to a clear next step without waiting to be rescued. You think in systems. You naturally turn chaos into steps, owners, and checkpoints. You have presence. You can hold the line with a busy business owner, warmly and professionally, and be taken seriously as their right hand, not an assistant. You stay composed under pressure and take feedback without losing your footing. You communicate like a real person, clear and direct, not rehearsed or robotic. If you go quiet when someone pushes back, or you wait to be told what to do, this isn't the role for you. What you'll do Own the EdgeOS rollout for your clients, keeping them on track with milestones and deliverables. Manage executive calendars and key meetings so leaders stay on the right priorities. Build and maintain scorecards, dashboards, playbooks, and memo systems, and drive their adoption. Track progress, follow up on action items, and hold people accountable to the plan. Problem-solve day-to-day blockers with clients and the team so work keeps moving. Communicate directly with clients to clarify expectations, gather information, and keep momentum. What you bring Advanced English (C1+), with clear, confident written and verbal communication. A proactive, organized, ownership-driven personality (this matters more to us than your resume). Strong problem-solving instincts: you don't freeze when things go sideways. Nice to have: experience in operations, project management, or executive support, and any exposure to process design or playbooks. If you don't have all of it, we train it. Reliability and a genuine interest in growing long-term, not a short-term gig.
